agent_evaluations.reviewer_notes: This OSCE station requires complete redesign of radiological interpretation content. Current version has generic placeholder text ('The investigations show findings consistent with Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis') instead of specific systematic interpretation. For AMC Clinical Examination standard, candidates must demonstrate: (1) ABCDE systematic CXR approach, (2) Structured HRCT reporting (distribution, pattern, ancillary features), (3) Spirometry interpretation (restrictive vs obstructive), (4) Integration of imaging with clinical context (Velcro crackles → basal fibrosis on imaging → IPF diagnosis). Current format would not assess radiology interpretation skills adequately. Recommend using PRD-OSCE-RADIOLOGY-INTERPRETATION template with embedded image interpretation rubrics and Australian RANZCR reporting standards.
